labels.learned: actor MLP from model_5999.pt (deterministic mean action)
labels.scripted: velocity commands (harness set); arm B frozen t=0 image; arm C analytic image
labels.oracle: arm C and the analytic nominal use the simulator's ground-truth camera pose to ray-cast the z=0 floor plane (privileged state)
labels.sim: MuJoCo flat biped scene, uniform friction (no ice patches); pushes off

predeclared.gate: A fall rate > 0.5 -> INCONCLUSIVE (sim2sim gap if matched blind fall rate <= 0.2, else harness)
predeclared.C_secondary: C within 0.1 fall and 20% disp of A
predeclared.Bsettle_secondary: (i)/(ii)/(iii) rules applied to Bsettle in place of B; reported, never replaces the primary B outcome
predeclared.pooled: episodes of gate-passing checkpoints only; none -> INCONCLUSIVE

protocol.paired: every arm of a (command, seed) starts from the identical state
